subject: Highliting or indicating specific sites in msa plot

messages.author: 34876aae73051821
messages.subject: Highliting or indicating specific sites in msa plot
parts:
Hello!
I'm wondering if there is a way to highlight or point to specific sites of interest in a multiple sequence alignment plot. For instance, I have an msa plot next to a phylogeny and I'm trying to highlight or indicate the specific sites of functional divergence between clades in the msa plot. I would just need to circle them or point the sites in the alignment. I'm using ggtree.

Best regards!!!

messages.author: 2a4584b898b0bd00
messages.subject: Re: Highliting or indicating specific sites in msa plot
parts:
maybe you need to propose a feature request in the ggmsa repo, https://github.com/YuLab-SMU/ggmsa

We will update msaplot based on the ggmsa package in future release.
